name: Data Product Trigger
description: Trigger an enrichment workflow from an upstream data product's event stream. Reads the referenced data product's bound queue and forwards each event to the downstream transform.
use_cases: Source an enrichment/transform workflow from an existing data product
Build staging/derived data products that read another data product's stream
Compose a data mesh: one data product feeds another via transforms

entity.name: Data Product Trigger
entity.description: Reads an upstream data product's bound queue and forwards events to the downstream transform chain.

source_data_product_id.description: Name or UUID of the upstream data product whose bound queue (its terminal/output queue) is the source of events for this enrichment workflow.

trigger_mode.description: on_event: wired directly into the downstream node's bot, no schedule (default). schedule: a relay bot reads a batch from the bound queue on `schedule`. manual: same relay bot, invoked on demand only.

checkpoint_start.description: Where to start reading the bound queue the first time this trigger deploys: 'earliest', 'now' (default), or an ISO-8601 timestamp. Ignored after the first successful deploy — later deploys keep the existing read position.

schedule.description: Cron expression or interval string (e.g. 'every 15m'); required when trigger_mode is 'schedule', ignored otherwise.

placeholders.{{SOURCE_DATA_PRODUCT_ID}}: Name or UUID of the upstream data product to read from
placeholders.{{CHECKPOINT_START}}: earliest | now (default) | ISO-8601 timestamp — first-deploy only
placeholders.{{TRIGGER_SCHEDULE}}: Cron/interval string; required when TRIGGER_MODE is schedule

connector_package.description: Design-time enrichment trigger. Resolves an upstream data product's bound queue; no runtime bot and no declarative HTTP actions.
follow_up_notes: Runtime: design-time only — deployment-orchestrator resolves configuration.source_data_product_id to the upstream product's bound queue; no CatalogRuntimeConnector and no native provider bot.
Test connection is the no-probe path (no external credentials).
actions[] stay empty: there is no outbound HTTP or platform_native action runner for this type.
